visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A dark-haired woman in a white long-sleeved shirt and black leggings walks down a narrow Indian street at night, flanked by rows of parked motorcycles and vibrant shops. (2) A vendor at a stall crushes sugarcane in a metal machine while a man in a pink shirt prepares a glass; the woman reaches for a fresh glass of yellowish juice. (3) A cook with a beard works over a large round griddle, preparing flatbreads or wraps in a steam-filled environment. (4) A young Asian man with a bright green scarf takes a massive bite out of a paper-wrapped food item, showing an intense facial expression. (5) A hand with green nail polish feeds a large cluster of thin yellow noodles into the man's mouth. (6) A vendor in a red cap skillfully pours white lassi between metal containers to create froth. (7) The man in the green scarf drinks the white lassi from a plastic cup, reacting with a wide-eyed, comical expression of surprise. (8) A vendor prepares pani puri, dipping fried dough shells into a large pot of green liquid. (9) The man eats a pani puri in one bite; red exclamation mark stickers appear on the screen to emphasize his reaction. (10) An older vendor in a green shirt prepares a leaf-wrapped paan in a small shop lined with colorful sachets. (11) The man in the green scarf stuffs a green leaf-wrapped item into his mouth, struggling to chew as he makes a funny face. (12) A vendor's hands are shown mixing ingredients into a paper container for a street snack. (13) The man eats the mixed snack with a plastic spoon, looking thoughtfully at the camera. (14) A vendor pours a bright yellow, thick beverage into a metal pot using a yellow plastic container. (15) The man takes a long sip of the yellow beverage, his eyes widening in a final humorous reaction shot.
